choices.content: They refer to the same seat.

question.prompt: Do the movie ticket labels “row 3, seat 5” and “row 5, seat 3” refer to the same seat?

solutions.explanation: “Row 3, seat 5” is the 5th seat in the 3rd row, while “row 5, seat 3” is the 3rd seat in the 5th row. The positions are different, showing that the order of the numbers in a pair cannot be interchanged arbitrarily.
solutions.title: Interpret the seat labels
